description: Put an image file from this computer into the file open in Figma Desktop: a PNG, JPG or GIF becomes a rectangle with the image fill (or the fill of the layer `nodeId`), and an SVG becomes editable vector layers. Use it for the project's own assets (logos, icons, photos) while designing; use_figma with figma.createImageAsync(url) takes images from the web. The new layer goes into `parentId` (default: the current page, right of its content), sized by `width`/`height` (one keeps the aspect ratio; default: the image's own size). Images larger than 4096 px on a side are scaled down by Figma.

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file. Accepted for compatibility; the file open in Figma Desktop is always used.

keepFills.description: With nodeId: add the image above the existing fills instead of replacing them.

nodeId.description: Set the image as the fill of this layer instead of making a new one (not for SVG).

parentId.description: Frame or group to put the new layer in.

path.description: Path of the image file (absolute, or relative to the project).

scaleMode.description: How the image fills the layer (default FILL).

name: place_image
title: Place Image
